summary: Iteration 114 — Frontend-only test of new WhatsAppShareCard (click-to-chat QR + copy-link) on Dashboard. Logged via auto-demo as admin@empresa.com, opened Dashboard tab, exercised every required interaction. ALL 8 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) card renders between ManagementKpisSection and view-mode selector; (2) green gradient header with 'Seu link de WhatsApp pra divulgar' + subtitle; (3) left column shows phone input + Salvar + pre-filled message textarea; right column shows QR SVG + 'Baixar QR SVG' button; (4) Copy button transitions to '✓ Copiado!' when clipboard granted, graceful window.prompt fallback otherwise; (5) link contains 'wa.me/55' and configured number 5521965680949; (6) editing textarea triggers auto-reload of link (debounced via useCallback dep on text); (7) saving phone 11999998888 persists across full page reload (backend normalized to 5511999998888); (8) revert to original 5521965680949 works. All data-testids present and correctly wired.

minor.issue: Pre-existing 500s during Dashboard load (overtimeTrend etc.) — unrelated to WhatsAppShareCard. Already noted in iteration_113. Visible as 'Erro: Request failed with status code 500' below the share card in screenshot but the share card itself works perfectly.

issues: Card is well-designed: green gradient header, centered QR with green border + shadow, clean two-column layout that collapses on narrow viewports (auto-fit minmax 220px). No contrast issues. Visually polished — matches the 'sticker / Instagram bio' use case described by the user.

critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppShareCard.js: copyLink fallback to window.prompt is good UX for environments without clipboard permission — verified working.

Backend normalizes phone with country code prefix (input '11999998888' came back as '5511999998888'). Behavior is sensible but undocumented in the UI — consider a small helper text like 'O 55 (Brasil) será adicionado automaticamente' under the phone input.
QR uses level='H' + includeMargin=false in a padded white box with green border — excellent scannability for printed stickers.
Textarea-driven reload re-fetches /click-to-chat on every keystroke (useCallback dep on text). Works but could be debounced 300ms to reduce API calls while typing long messages.
downloadQr serializes the SVG directly from DOM — clean approach, no canvas conversion needed for SVG download.
test_credentials: admin@empresa.com / 123456 — auto-demo login (no manual form interaction needed in preview env).
